hypothesis: Every-pass paired integer durations expose minimum-selection sensitivity and permit future median-pass engine screens. Recording on/off uses one exact executable to bound observer cost, not a speed candidate.
primary: Descriptive paired on/off CPU rate ratios, all captured CPU/wall minima identities and median/min duration ratios. No statistical acceptance or runtime promotion; 12 pairs, no exclusions or extensions.
stop: Exactly 24 successful sequential sessions or incomplete evidence; do not retry failures. Five unmodified-payload passes per workload. No benchmark tuning.
limits: Shared host, same executable compiled with recorder code in both modes; not a comparison to the old executable.
Clock-read resolution is not timing accuracy. CPU and wall clocks have adjacent, not identical, endpoints.
Does not establish terminal/Ghostty speed, rendering/input-latency/pacing, independent samples, or championship.
